dct_description_sm:
This dataset represents single station flood frequency estimates for the Water Survey of Canada’s (WSC) HYDAT gauges in the Great Lakes – St. Lawrence watershed systems that lie within the Province of Ontario.

Statistics include the flood magnitude with the following recurrence intervals:
  • 1:2 years
  • 1:2.33 years
  • 1: 5 years
  • 1:10 years
  • 1:20 years
  • 1:25 years
  • 1:50 years
  • 1:100 years
  • 1:200 years
  • 1: 500 years
These flood statistics can be used for applications such as floodplain delineation and the design of hydraulic structures.
